description: List the tenant's demand curves — reusable seasonal/lifecycle shape profiles that re-time an item's forecast across the year. Each row carries the curve's 12 monthly points (stored mean-normalized: they average 1.0, so a curve can never change an item's annual volume by itself), its calendar start month, and how many item assignments currently carry it. Optionally filter by a name/description search substring. Paged: returns Total (pre-paging) plus the page; default 100, max 500 per call.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against name or description.

name: list_demand_curves
title: List Demand Curves
